Cluster boot/configuration and metrics inspection outside timing. Each alternating pair owns and closes its metrics cluster so completed host aggregate state cannot remain reachable across pairs.

profile_configuration: Initial unfused prototype, 500k source rows per case, two warmups/three pairs, software cpu-clock2ms, DWARF native stacks, threads and Java alloc1m. Both split and grouped-JSON cases completed with positive native-consumption checks. Profiled timings excluded from acceleration claims.
profile_findings: Redundant NativeCalc projection/JNI boundary and writes of discarded correlate columns are visible on producer stacks. Rust group update, JSON serialization, allocations/copies and state-output work appear on grouped native stacks. Inclusive frames overlap; native allocation calls do not provide allocation-byte totals. Raw Java allocation profiles do not measure Rust allocated bytes or peak heap.
decision: Admit verified basic synchronous JVM table functions by default after stock/actual-previous release comparisons on both Flink lines, including wide STRING and numeric types. Preserve explicit fallback for other/specialized signatures. JVM aggregate/OVER and nested scalar support remain open under #237.
limits: Stock medians drift between separate JVMs; do not attribute the entire unfused/pruned difference to one change.
The unfused control uses the same compiled producer with an identity projected view; it is a layout control, not the preceding released implementation.
The grouped win includes existing native JSON aggregation; standalone and grouped boundaries are reported separately.
Other types, specialized functions and other JVM function kinds remain outside admission; benchmarks do not establish all-function acceleration.

expanded_validation.configuration: Same released JDK17/release+mimalloc/per-pair-cleanup timing boundary, p1,2GiB,1024row transposes,IPC,two warmups/five alternating pairs. Wide and numeric cases use2Mrows/65536keys. Previous group1.18 uses500k/16384keys.
expanded_validation.wide: 128 characters per token, including é. Same two-token split and every-eighth NULL text.
expanded_validation.numeric: INT key and BIGINT value inputs; two emitted ROW<n BIGINT,pos INT> values per non-NULL input, every eighth value NULL. Numeric source has no STRING payload; width property printed by shared logger is unused.
expanded_validation.numeric_query: SELECT s.k,t.n,t.pos FROM src s,LATERAL TABLE(numeric_rows(s.k,s.n)) AS t(n,pos)
expanded_validation.decision: All candidate ranges lie below paired stock ranges and below actual preceding-revision ranges. Admit verified VARCHAR/INT/BIGINT table functions by default; unsupported/specialized signatures retain fallback. Separate-JVM controls drift; report whole-job improvements without isolated-cost attribution.

admitted_path_profiles.configuration: Default-admitted production path, Flink2.2.1/JDK17, 500krows/16384keys, numeric and 128-character grouped split cases. Two warmups/three pairs per case, fresh cluster per pair, release+mimalloc/2GiB/IPC/both transposes. cpu-clock2ms/DWARF native stacks/Javaalloc1m. Profiled durations excluded from acceleration claims.
